:::{#exm-exp-neg-log-odds-auto}
#### The exponential of minus the log-odds that a car in the Auto data is American

<!-- no-figure: the example checks one number computed two ways -->

For the [event](#def-event) $A$ of @exm-odds-auto,
@lem-exp-neg-log-odds says that the [exponential](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-exponential-function) of minus the [log-odds](#def-log-odds)
is one over the [odds](#def-odds):

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
odds_american <- p_american / (1 - p_american)
log_odds_american <- log(odds_american)
exp_neg_log_odds <- exp(-log_odds_american)
c(exp_neg_log_odds = exp_neg_log_odds, one_over_odds = 1 / odds_american)
```

Both ways give `{r} round(exp_neg_log_odds, 3)`.
:::
